title.zh: 合作、供應與組織持有，是不同承諾
title.en: Alliances, supply and ownership are different commitments

reader_question.zh: 同樣布局ADC，企業究竟取得什麼、又由誰負責把候選藥往前推？
reader_question.en: When companies invest in ADCs, what do they obtain and who is responsible for moving each candidate forward?

takeaway.zh: 同一DXd平台可連結不同全球夥伴；看清資產、地域權利與製造責任，才能看懂合作的價值。
takeaway.en: One DXd platform can connect with different global partners; assets, territorial rights and manufacturing responsibilities explain the value of each alliance.

caption.zh: 選列R1已有的合作配置：第一三共以不同DXd資產連結AstraZeneca與Merck，並承擔所列合作資產的製造供應；Gilead收購Tubulis，取得資產、平台與團隊。連線只表示已披露的特定關係，不代表所有公司互有合約。合作原始日期見圖；來源回讀2026-10-07。[D01][R07][D16]
caption.en: Selected alliances already covered in R1: Daiichi Sankyo connects different DXd assets with AstraZeneca and Merck and is responsible for manufacturing and supply of the listed partnered assets. Gilead acquired Tubulis, including its assets, platform and team. Lines represent only the disclosed relationships shown. Original agreement dates appear in the figure; sources re-read on 2026-10-07. [D01][R07][D16]

units_currency: Not applicable; the map uses qualitative relationships and disclosed calendar dates. It contains no transaction amounts, market shares, revenue estimates or scale-proportional node sizes.
not_verified_in_this_increment: All 89 R1 sources: only D01, R07 and D16 were directly re-read for this map.
No unreported supplier orders, downstream revenue benefit or head-to-head platform superiority is inferred from role similarity.
No new listing verification: the map intentionally omits exchanges and ticker symbols.
D01 is the original 2023 announcement; later payment disclosures and amendments remain in R1 and were not re-read here.
Gilead Trodelvy commercial ownership is not an edge in this three-source map; D16 does not name Trodelvy in its substantive body.
This bounded source read is author source work, not an independent whole-report QA verdict.
